values: မူရင်းကို စားပွဲပေါ်သို့ — ဒေသထွက်ပါဝင်ပစ္စည်း အတွေ့အကြုံပြပွဲ
Consumers may enjoy a dish but lack a clear, non-exaggerated reason to choose it again when multiple F&B options feel interchangeable.
Urban food-curious adults, local-product shoppers and invited hospitality/community stakeholders; exact audience and eligibility TBC.
A three-station tasting card unlocks a QR ingredient/story card and a voluntary next-step preference selection; any order, delivery or purchase destination is client-approved/TBC.
The ingredient has a place, a season and a hand behind it.
G1 factual product and claims approval
အရသာရှာဖွေရေး — လမ်းညွှန်ထားသော Shelf-to-Sip Discovery Trail
New beverages or snack variants can be overlooked when choice overload makes shoppers default to familiar products.
Client-defined retail visitors and adult beverage/snack shoppers; retail access and age/category rules TBC.
A five-question flavour card issues a route token to two or three client-approved discovery points, ending in a voluntary preference capture or offer reveal.
Do not browse the shelf. Follow your flavour.
G1 factual product and claims approval
၁၅ မိနစ် စားပွဲ — အလျင်မြန်အစားအစာ Kit အတွေ့အကြုံ
Busy households may perceive convenient food as less satisfying or too difficult to fit into their own routines.
Time-pressed households and working adults; all product, ingredient and dietary suitability details TBC.
Visitors select a real-life meal moment, watch a timed but non-performance-guaranteed demo, and reserve a limited client-approved trial kit or demonstration slot.
A real table can begin before the day has finished.
G1 factual product and claims approval
ပိုကောင်းတဲ့ နားချိန် — အလုပ်ခွင် Meal Discovery Programme
B2B workplace tasting and procurement clinic
Office meal or pantry decisions can remain price-only conversations, leaving service fit, dietary information and ordering workflow unexplored.
Client-defined HR, operations, procurement and workplace-experience decision-makers; employer access TBC.
A short preference-and-operations card produces a named tasting/scoping appointment; no catering capacity or outcome is promised at the activation.
A break should work as hard as the team does.
G1 factual product and claims approval
တစ်ပွဲတည်း၊ လက်များစွာ — Open-Kitchen Craft Table
A food brand may have a credible making process, yet customers see only the finished dish and cannot distinguish craft from generic promotion.
Food-interested consumers, invited media/creators and client-defined guests; chef, venue and media participation TBC.
A clearly timed demonstration ends with a question card, a controlled tasting sequence and an optional waitlist or session request.
The making is part of the meal.
G1 factual product and claims approval
တိတ်ဆိတ်တဲ့ ခွက် — ကော်ဖီနှင့် လက်ဖက်ရည် Sensory Masterclass
Coffee and tea communication can become technical or status-led, making curious newcomers reluctant to ask questions or return.
Adult coffee/tea-curious participants; beverage, venue, age and dietary policies TBC.
A guided aroma/flavour scorecard produces a self-selected learning profile and optional registration for a future session, tasting pack or client-approved update.
Your taste already knows where to begin.
G1 factual product and claims approval
စားပွဲငယ်များ၏ မြို့ — ရပ်ကွက်အစားအစာ Passport
Independent food businesses may have distinct offers but little shared mechanism to help people discover, compare and return responsibly.
Client-approved adult visitors and participating local businesses; route, safety, access, partners and operating hours TBC.
A digital/print passport records client-approved visits or learning moments, then offers a voluntary preference capture and future route update.
A good city is remembered one small table at a time.
G1 factual product and claims approval
မျှဝေစားပွဲ — Hosting Pre-Order Activation
Seasonal hosting pop-up and group-order conversion
People planning a shared meal can lack confidence in what to order, how much to choose or how to coordinate a group without over-ordering.
Client-defined households, office hosts and community organisers; service area and eligibility TBC.
A table-size planner creates a non-binding hosting card and offers an optional client-approved pre-order or consultation request.
The table begins with the people you are thinking of.
G1 factual product and claims approval
ဝယ်ယူသူအတွက် တစ်ကိုက် — MSME Food Trade Preview
Curated B2B trade preview and buyer-meeting clinic
Emerging food producers may generate interest yet lack a structured, realistic route to a buyer conversation, product review or next qualification step.
Client-approved food buyers, distributors, hospitality/procurement leads and invited MSME producers; participant selection TBC.
A structured buyer card captures criteria and issues a named, consented follow-up request after a client-approved product interaction.
One good bite should open a better conversation.
G1 factual product and claims approval
ဒုတိယအကြိမ် စားသုံးမှု — Feedback-to-Return Packaging Lab
Product-feedback pop-up and CRM reactivation programme
A first trial may not become a repeat habit because brands often learn too little about the actual serving, storage, pack-opening or re-order friction.
Existing client-approved customers or invited trial participants; product/category and data permissions TBC.
A guided pack-use review captures a priority friction and lets the participant select a future update, trial or client-approved repeat-purchase prompt.
The next serving begins with what the first one taught us.
G1 factual product and claims approval
